name: io.github.murilojrpereira/mcp-graphql-bridge
description: Bridges any GraphQL API to Claude Code — auto-generates MCP tools via schema introspection.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: GraphQL endpoint URL used for executing queries and mutations. Defaults to the public Countries API.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION_URL
environmentVariables.description: GraphQL endpoint URL used for schema introspection. Defaults to GRAPHQL_API_URL.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for authenticating query and mutation execution.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_INTROSPECTION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for schema introspection. Defaults to GRAPHQL_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_MAX_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of generated query and mutation tools. Defaults to 128.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_INCLUDE_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable mutation tools and mutation execution. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: GRAPHQL_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries for transient upstream responses. Defaults to 0.
